name: copilot-studio-mcp
description: MCP server for Microsoft Copilot Studio agent development: workspace sync via pac, YAML authoring (topics, knowledge, tools, flows), evaluations and chat-testing.

copilotStudioMcp.nodePath.markdownDescription: Node executable used to run the server. Empty means the first `node` on PATH (Node 20 or newer), falling back to the editor's own Node. The editor's Node cannot load the native token cache, so sign-ins are not remembered between sessions when it is used.

copilotStudioMcp.serverPath.markdownDescription: Run a checkout of `copilot-studio-mcp` instead of the copy bundled with this extension. Either the repository root (must contain `dist/index.js`) or the path to `dist/index.js` itself.

copilotStudioMcp.workspaceFolder.markdownDescription: Agent workspace the server starts from (`CPS_WORKSPACE`). Empty means the first folder open in VS Code. Supports `${workspaceFolder}` and `${userHome}`.

copilotStudioMcp.readOnly.markdownDescription: Withhold every tool that can change a Copilot Studio environment (`CPS_READ_ONLY`). Local authoring, validation and read-only tools still work.

copilotStudioMcp.tools.markdownDescription: Tool preset or allow-list (`CPS_TOOLS`), for example `core`, `authoring`, `admin`, `solutions`, `full`, or a comma-separated list of names and globs such as `cs_init,cs_add_*`. Empty registers all tools, which is a large tool list for a smaller model.

copilotStudioMcp.toolsExclude.markdownDescription: Comma-separated names or globs to hide (`CPS_TOOLS_EXCLUDE`), applied after the preset.

copilotStudioMcp.environmentId.markdownDescription: Default Power Platform environment id (`CPS_ENVIRONMENT_ID`), used when a tool call and the workspace do not name one.

copilotStudioMcp.tenantId.markdownDescription: Entra tenant id (`CPS_TENANT_ID`). Empty signs in against `organizations`.

copilotStudioMcp.clientId.markdownDescription: Application (client) id used for sign-in (`CPS_CLIENT_ID`). Empty uses the first-party VS Code client id.

copilotStudioMcp.pacProfile.markdownDescription: Name of the `pac` auth profile used for maker commands (`CPS_PAC_PROFILE`).

copilotStudioMcp.adminProfile.markdownDescription: Name of the `pac` auth profile used for admin commands (`CPS_ADMIN_PROFILE`).

copilotStudioMcp.pacPath.markdownDescription: Full path to the `pac` executable (`PAC_PATH`). Empty searches PATH and the usual install locations.
